controls.name: Speed
controls.doc: params[5]. Tape-motor speed the head ALWAYS trends toward: 0=-1x reverse, 25=stop, 50=+1x normal, 100=+2x octave up. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Chnce
controls.doc: params[6]. How often random speed/direction slips happen. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Depth
controls.doc: params[7]. How far a slip deviates from Speed (0 = slips do nothing, pure speed control; 100 = fully random tape warps). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Glide
controls.doc: params[8]. Tape-motor smoothness: 0 = snappy/abrupt speed jumps, 100 = long smooth pitch glides. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: Mix default 1 (quiet-safe). The editor materialises patches on load (full-patch send), so audible-on-load no longer needs a hot default. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.
